teaser.text: Zijin Mining Group Co. Ltd. is a mining, refining and trading company: it takes metal from the ground, processes it, and moves metal through industrial markets. To understand how a dollar comes in and goes out, follow three links: what it sells, what each unit costs, and who pays for it.

stock.title: Zijin stock forecast
stock.meta_description: Zijin's stock forecast sets out weighted scenarios, the cash behind them and the valuation investors are paying today.
stock.opening: Zijin's weighted scenario reaches HKD51.04 in October 2029, a 67% return including dividends from HKD32.90. Zijin's forecast hinges on Kamoa's dewatering and production recovery.
stock.closing: The full memo also explains Zijin's business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: Where could Zijin's shares be by 2029?

paragraphs.text: The weighted price reaches HKD39.63 in October 2027, a 24% total return including dividends from HKD32.90. It reaches HKD43.32 in October 2028, a 39% return. By October 2029, it reaches HKD51.04, a 67% return. The bear-to-bull range at that final date is HKD29.70 to HKD76.78.

blocks.heading: What has to go right or wrong for Zijin?

paragraphs.text: EBITDA is the central operating judgment. FY2025 EBITDA was CNY101,363m on diluted EPS of CNY1.91. Scaling that record by the current NTM EPS estimate of CNY3.03657 gives the base starting point of CNY161,149m. The base case grows to CNY177,264m in 2028 and CNY191,445m in 2029 as Kamoa recovers and projects ramp. The bear case falls to CNY145,000m, then CNY124,700m, before recovering to CNY134,700m because weaker prices, higher costs and delays outweigh new output. The bull case starts at CNY170,000m and reaches CNY213,248m because supportive gold and copper prices coincide with successful execution. Zijin’s EBITDA rose each year from 2021 to 2025, but realized metal prices also rose sharply.

The bull case reaches HKD50.11 first and HKD76.78 last, with a 20% probability. It requires Kamoa to restore output, Julong to sustain its ramp and new capacity to deliver at controlled costs. A 7–8x multiple also requires investors to trust execution above diversified peers, so several favorable outcomes must coincide.

blocks.heading: How much cash does Zijin really make?

paragraphs.text: Capital spending was RMB30,982.3 million. After lease payments and interest, free cash flow was RMB39,773.4 million; after stock-based pay, the analytical measure called real free cash flow was RMB39,547.4 million.

blocks.heading: What do investors pay for Zijin today?

paragraphs.text: Free cash flow yield is 5.3%, but dividend yield is only 2.1%. The first measures cash left after the spending included in the calculation; the second measures what management actually distributes. Construction, debt repayment and safety buffers can absorb cash even when mines generate it.

dividend.title: Zijin dividend
dividend.meta_description: Zijin’s forecast dividend per share, cash coverage, payout flows and key risks in one concise view.
dividend.opening: Zijin’s forecast dividend per share rises from CNY1.13 to CNY1.20 and then CNY1.31 in the base case; the latest interim dividend was CNY0.42. Its 2025 free cash flow was RMB39,773.420745 million and left RMB20,363.765632 million after minority distributions, dividends and buybacks, while free cash flow yield was 5.3% versus a 2.1% dividend yield.
dividend.closing: The full memo also explains how Zijin makes money, competes with rivals, is managed, and faces risks.

blocks.heading: How much does Zijin pay per share?

paragraphs.text: Base DPS rises from CNY1.13 to CNY1.20 and then CNY1.31 per share, following the 35% aggregate distributable-profit commitment. The bear path stays near CNY0.78 because weaker earnings and investment needs restrict distributions. The bull path reaches CNY1.70 because earnings growth supports a payout above policy. The latest interim dividend was already CNY0.42.

blocks.heading: Does Zijin’s dividend come from its cash?

paragraphs.text: The funding picture improved sharply. In 2025, free cash flow reached RMB39,773.420745 million, leaving RMB20,363.765632 million after minority distributions, dividends and buybacks. Acquisitions then consumed RMB15,438.270547 million. Zijin repaid RMB70,866.568168 million of debt while issuing more debt, so some repayment represented refinancing rather than a complete retreat from borrowing.

paragraphs.text: The view would move toward the bear case if realized copper and gold prices weaken during 2027–2029, or if Kamoa remains near its revised guidance while project spending stays high. Higher taxes, weaker cash conversion or reduced dividends in 2028–2029 would add pressure.

It would move toward the bull case if Kamoa dewatering succeeds, Julong maintains throughput and commissioning milestones arrive during 2027–2028. Stronger cash generation in 2028–2029 would then support debt reduction and higher distributions.

earnings.meta_description: Zijin's next results are expected on October 24, 2026; guidance covers gold, copper, lithium and Kamoa's revised copper outlook.
earnings.opening: Zijin's next results are expected on October 24, 2026. Watch sustained production and the tax cost of earning it.
earnings.closing: The full Zijin memo also answers questions about its business, rivals, management and risks.

blocks.heading: What has Zijin guided for the year?

paragraphs.text: Management guides to 105 tonnes of mine-produced gold and 1.2 million tonnes of mine-produced copper. It also targets 120 thousand tonnes of lithium carbonate equivalent. These are production targets, not earnings promises, because profit still depends on prices, costs and taxes.

Flooding at Kamoa-Kakula in the Democratic Republic of Congo reduced the mine’s planned annual copper range to 290–330 thousand tonnes. The lower range was disclosed after the earlier plan, but the important question is how much of that loss belongs to Zijin.

blocks.heading: Did Zijin keep its past promises?

paragraphs.text: Repurchasing shares does not automatically prevent dilution. Shares placed with employees reduce the effect of the buyback, while options can increase the diluted share count. Operating delivery was also mixed: gold exceeded its plan, while copper and lithium fell short. The useful test is therefore whether rewards follow durable cash generation and returns per share.

blocks.heading: What is Zijin's last eight-quarter results trend?

paragraphs.text: June 2026 showed stronger profitability than a year earlier. Revenue reached RMB95,680.9 million, compared with RMB88,782.6 million in June 2025. Net income rose to RMB19,090.4 million from RMB13,125.0 million, while gross margin reached 39.2% against 24.5%.
